name: Slonks Image Model
description: The on-chain neural network for Slonks: it regenerates each 24x24 image from stored weights, pixel by pixel.
about:
## Role in the Slonks system

This contract holds the weights of a compact image model, trained on the full CryptoPunks set and stored fully on-chain, that reconstructs each Slonk image. It is read by the **SlonksRenderer** (`0x726383bd28fa1f95a7e3d300babf08f6444d0437`) which serves the **Slonks** NFT (`0x832233ddb7bcffd0ed53127dd6be3f1aa5845108`).

The owner permanently locked this deployment after supplying its weight pointers and configuration. The weights and model configuration can no longer be changed.
risks: The model is permanently locked, so any defect in its weights or configuration cannot be corrected

renderSourcePixels.title: Render Source Pixels
renderSourcePixels.description: Run the model for a CryptoPunks source id and return the generated pixels.

predictSourcePixel.title: Predict Source Pixel
predictSourcePixel.description: Return the model's predicted palette index for a single pixel of a source id.

renderEmbeddingPixels.title: Render Embedding Pixels
renderEmbeddingPixels.description: Run the model on a raw embedding and return the generated pixels.

predictEmbeddingPixel.title: Predict Embedding Pixel
predictEmbeddingPixel.description: Return the model's predicted palette index for one pixel of a raw embedding.

modelLocked.title: Model Locked
modelLocked.description: Whether the model weights and configuration have been permanently frozen.

setWeightChunks.title: Set Weight Chunks
setWeightChunks.description: Replace the weight pointer contracts. This deployment is already locked, so the call reverts.
setWeightChunks.deprecated: Unavailable: the model is permanently locked.

setConfig.title: Set Config
setConfig.description: Replace the model configuration. This deployment is already locked, so the call reverts.
setConfig.deprecated: Unavailable: the model is permanently locked.

lockModel.title: Lock Model
lockModel.description: Permanently freeze the model. This deployment is already locked, so the call reverts.
lockModel.deprecated: Unavailable: the model is already permanently locked.

setMetadataNotifier.title: Set Metadata Notifier
setMetadataNotifier.description: Set the contract notified to emit metadata updates on model changes. Only the owner can call this.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer Ownership
transferOwnership.description: Transfer ownership of the model contract. Only the owner can call this.
